capabilities: Add captions to images using the alt text
Resize and align images (center, float left/right)
Render inline Markdown and links inside captions
Use the image filename as the caption via %
Filter caption text with a custom regex in settings
extras: Caption format follows the CommonMark spec for compatibility with other Markdown applications; includes regex examples for ITS Theme pipe syntax; styling via .image-captions-figure and .image-captions-caption CSS classes.
intentEvidence: This plugin was based on concepts from
problem: Obsidian displays images without captions, so describing or labeling an image inline in a note is not possible.
summary: Renders captions under images from the image's Markdown alt text, with inline Markdown, links, resizing, alignment, and optional filename captions.
